name: VF-9000 VersaFrame 18 x 18 SDI transceiver, muxed (A end)
notes: 1RU frame with 9 rear I/O card slots and dual internal hot-swap PSUs (C13 cords, 25 W max). Each video card has 2 BNCs (or 4 HD-BNCs) on the rear and one or two SFP cages on the front; BNC direction follows the SFP fitted (dual TX SFP makes inputs, dual RX makes outputs). Muxed (-2M) versions carry 36 signals on 2 single-mode fibres through the internal CWDM mux (LC on the front); -FP versions use one fibre per channel from the SFPs. Other cards: audio, MADI, serial/GPIO, Ethernet, HDMI, genlock. 483 x 191 mm deep. Ports shown with 2 BNCs per channel position (4 channels per card on muxed units, 2 BNCs each in and out). Check: exact BNC count of this configuration and where the management port is (on the front here).

name: HoneyBadger remote (field) unit, 8 x 8 12G-SDI
notes: Fibre-linked pair (one remote, one local) carrying 8 SDI each way, audio, intercom, data and 2 x GbE. Order -N2 for an opticalCON DUO fibre port or -ST2 for dual ST (LEMO 304M also offered); -AB / -V adds an Anton Bauer or V-mount battery plate. 200 W max, 318 mm deep without handles, 10 kg. 3G versions replace 12G in the part number. Check: which connectors are on the front and which on the rear (shown all on the front).
